test_cases.name: Danish Pastry - Quote Request with Additional Information
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items and also asks for unsupported information such as technical documentation and packaging specifications.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Toys and Packaging Details
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I am reaching out to request a formal quote for the following items for our upcoming retail promotion:

- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train
- SmartToys Building Blocks
- JoySprout Toy Bicycle

In addition to the pricing, could you please provide the technical documentation for each of these products? We are particularly interested in any available specifications, assembly instructions, and safety certifications. Furthermore, it would be very helpful if you could include the dimensions and weight of the boxes, as well as any packaging specifications (such as material type and whether the packaging is recyclable). This information is important for our logistics planning and compliance checks.

If you require any further details from our side, please let me know. Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

I hope this message finds you well. I am interested in obtaining a quote for the following items from your catalog:

- 2 units of the WonderWagon Electric Train
- 5 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks

I would also appreciate information regarding the weight of the boxes for all items listed, as this will help us estimate shipping and storage requirements.

If there are any details you need from my side to proceed, please let me know. Thank you very much for your assistance, and I look forward to your prompt response.

Best regards,
Mario Adams
